notes.title: Beta 0.51.1 Update
notes.content:
- Changed to steams auto cloud synch. Save Files are now stored in users AppData folder.
- Permadeath players and achievements were removed from the game
- Bugfix: Creature Kill Info overlapping problem with Weapon Jamming text
- Bugfix: selecting Master Class removed the wrong class

notes.title: Update to Beta 0.51
notes.content:
A lot of improvements came to Zombiepede:
- Wave Counter and Health Info for dark skeleton waves in late game
- multiplayer challenges became more difficult
- bug fix: mines were exploding when placing in friendly fire levels
- bug fix: Lich was flying out of the level in the Event Challenge
- Some changes for the greneade launcher updates: for example Speed updates decreased and chances for legendarys to epic
- New Campaign (4: Hardcore) with 5 new difficult levels added
- removed sound spamming of fire golems in late
- added button info for Event challenge
- dark fire golems added to late game 
- late game changes to weaker enemies: appear less often for better performance
- new Weapons: Lightninger and Golden Gun
- new Air Strike offer
- made changes to pistol class and general updates: appear more often in early
- Death increases the reroll cost by 1+20% now
- added Blast upgrade to Machine Guns
- Overclock damage increased
- added new Skin
- added two new Profiles: Contract and Master
- some more minor bug fixes...

notes.title: Beta 0.5 Update
notes.content:
A lot of changes found there way to Zombiepede. 
In the 0.5 Update we have a lot of bug fixes but cause of some new systems probably some new bugs for the multiplayer mode. Beside that there are:
- new Soldier and Tech Items to use with your Analog Sticks, which add different strategies to the game
- a new credit system, to unlock profiles and weapons
- new Weapon System with Primary, Secondary and Special Weapon
- a new Tutorial 
- new and easyer Level 1
- new weapons
- new Intro

notes.title: Update beta 0.4.1
notes.content: Added play-tips for the first Level and control infos in pause menu to make the first run easier

notes.title: Beta 0.4 Update
notes.content:
- many minor changes
- Glock bullet speed increased
- mission unlocked bugfix

notes.title: Update to beta 0.3.1
notes.content:
- you loose 30% of your highscore if not rescued now
- Bugfix: Skin was not unlocked for second player
- new Level visuals

notes.title: Update to Beta 0.3
notes.content:
added Force Feedback when beeing hit and rescued
 New weapons: Railgun, Plasma Turret
 New Upgrades: Scope, Repair, Calmness, Scalpel, Contrat, Self Defense
 Bugfix: Player Order in Menu
 Bugfix: Overclocked was causing additional Blue Costs when buying mines
 Rescue Calls must be confirmed with pressing X now
 New Levels: Pressure, Surrounded, Darkness
 Hero Stats can be shown by pressing Left D-Pad in Shop
 New sound and visual effects for Skeletons in Tutorial
 New Gem collect animation
 New Badges System for Killing a specific type of enemies with new shop offers
 New Walk,Crouch, Reload and Jam Animations
 Changed from Unreal Engine 4.27 to Unreal Engine 5.2
 Added a Skin selection which can be unlocked by earning achievements

notes.title: Beta Update 0.2.411
notes.content: - Added new Shop Layout to improve understanding

notes.title: Beta update 0.2.41
notes.content:
- Bug fixed where skeletons didn't take damage from revive explosion
- skeletons stop moving when hitting heros now
- added rescue zone to the tutorial, that plays know they must go below the ship

notes.title: Beta Update 0.2.4
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the player order was wrong when reactivating a player
- Gras added
- A car showing the shop availability was added
- the aircraft mesh was changed
- shooting animations were added
- volume of different weapons is changed depending on the attackspeed and duration, or amount of turrets. multiple sounds of the same type aren't spawned in the same moment.
- Fixed a bug where you couldn't continue the tutorail when you unlocked a profile
- fixed a bug where you couldn't leave the game, when you do this while shop is closing.

notes.title: beta 0.2.31
notes.content:
fixed bug where total score of campaigns wasn't shown
 added music volume settings
 add leaderboard support for permadeath total scores

notes.title: Beta Update 0.2.3
notes.content:
highscores and medals are stored on each player now. progress is reset. In multiplayer you can see each medal and the lowest highscore is shown in the overview. in the sidebars you can see the individual highscores. necessary medals to play a level depend on the player amount now.
 a permadeath mode was added which can only be played with an Internet connection. 
 rescue highscore bonus bug fixed and increased to 30%
 new design for highscore
 credits added
 some windows game icons added
